name: Omakvm
author: Faeric
description: Share one keyboard, mouse and clipboard between two Omarchy machines on the same Tailscale network.

barWidget.description: Push the pointer off the edge of one screen and carry on typing on the other machine. Choose the machine and the edge it sits on; installing and pairing follow.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the state is checked while the panel is closed.
